item.title: Week 10: Dolphins at Colts
item.description:
Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: IND -4.5 · O/U 37.5 | Model IND 58% vs. market 66% | On paper, Indianapolis has the edge, led by its ground game: it ranks 7th in EPA per designed run (-0.04) against a Miami defense ranked 31st (-0.07 allowed). Miami's best counter is explosive plays, where it ranks 22nd in explosive play rate (8.4%) against an Indianapolis defense ranked 31st (9.5% allowed).
No Miami quarterback rank is provided, so only Indianapolis' Daniel Jones can be placed: 28th of 31 in EPA per dropback, and 30th of 31 under pressure (-1.30), against a Miami pass rush ranked 14th (23% of dropbacks).
The model also favors Indianapolis at 58% win probability, driven mainly by the rushing matchup (3.5 points toward Indianapolis) and home field (1.7 points), while the market is higher at 66%.
